source: sportsdataverse/cfbfastR-data schedules/csv/cfb_schedules_2025.csv on branch main (repository HEAD 935eed66a08c95822992fd182495848ac4303f96 at capture; raw snapshot sha256 bfecf10bc5a8ffd2e3b6a76b5f0b03b406e17c1a0e03b2000bdf7e2263712db4).
note: Canonical CFB schedule and result facts for FBS-involved games only. Upstream modelled columns (win probabilities, ESPN Elo, excitement index) are deliberately excluded: they are model outputs, not facts, and carry no methodology metadata. Git history retains every changed snapshot; downstream work must record integrity.snapshot_id.

integrity.algorithm: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON for data.games (sorted object keys, no insignificant whitespace).

tier_meaning: Labs — useful and live, still being challenged. Open questions may remain about calibration, assumptions, data quality or edge. Use with your eyes open.
